provider.name: codex-sale
provider.note: Synthetic upstream probes only. Six completed distinct decisions matched the existing policy. One prompt-injection case timed out twice and was held without publication or sanction; no universal latency guarantee.

limitations: Real local WS/auth/database E2E used an isolated PostgreSQL and development moderation fallback; the external model was separately probed using only synthetic texts.
Client failure/reconnect/watchdog tests use the real host with a local transport sink and no production writes.
Outbox is kept in the current page, and does not claim durable storage after closing or reloading the tab.
